turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and why wasn't I called first?
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
A law degree. My son has a zero and no phone call. Who decided?
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then answer like you're not. What do you have besides that checker?
